last_run: Made the brain's Close Call record honest before its first grades come in (Nov 19). It used to say the brain 'beat the market's odds' whenever its score was a hair better, even on 11 questions that all closed on the same day and rode the same market move. Now it says 'too early to say' until questions have closed on 5 different days, and after that only calls better or worse when the gap is bigger than luck would explain (each closing day counted once). It also shows how often the market's odds alone picked the right side, so the brain's hit rate has something to be compared with.
